author: reek
body: Known-answer test for the Lens modeling vocabulary. Builds the sample model from the design document, orders joined many-to-one to users with a controller-approved net revenue measure, and requires it to validate clean. Then builds four deliberately broken models that between them trip every diagnostic code in the table, and prints each diagnostic as code plus message.

author: reek
body: Four mutations of the sample. The first joins through two tables the model never declares. The second strips the primary key from users so the many-to-one join loses its grain anchor. The third points a dimension and a measure at tables that do not exist. The fourth declares the orders table and the net revenue measure twice each.

author: reek
body: A model's validation report renders as the single word valid when the diagnostic list is empty, otherwise one line per diagnostic.
